name: Green River (United States)
description: A landscape: orange mesas under a light blue sky with a white flower in the upper fly, over green and dark green wavy bands for the Green River.
history: Green River is a city in Emery County, Utah. The flag was created with residents by designer Jarod Hamm and artist Ashley Ross through surveys, a design workshop and a public vote among three finalists, according to Flags of the World.

features.role: green wavy bands for the river
